notices.title: Library timings during the Diwali break
notices.body: The Central Library will be closed on 2026-11-08 (Diwali). On the other Diwali break days (2026-11-07 and 2026-11-09 to 2026-11-11) it will be open from 09:00 to 17:00 only. Normal timings (08:00 to 22:00, Monday to Saturday) resume on 2026-11-12. Books due during the break can be returned on 2026-11-12 without a fine.
notices.author: XYZ Admin Office

notices.title: Lab practical exams for CSE and ECE on 2026-11-26 and 2026-11-27
notices.body: End-semester lab practical exams for CSE and ECE (all semesters) will be held on 2026-11-26 and 2026-11-27, from 09:00 to 13:00, in the department labs. The batch-wise schedule is on the student portal. Bring your lab record and college ID card. A hall ticket is not needed for lab practicals.
notices.author: XYZ Admin Office
